==LSGTKV Profile==
I've been a fan of [[The Wheel of Time]] since I was introduced to it by a school friend while I was in the middle years of High School. That was almost 15 years ago now.

I've read the series the whole way through about four times (maybe 3, I can't remember). I'm about to start on my next read through starting from [[New Spring]] in anticipation for the first installment of the last novel.

I've always enjoyed reading these novels and I am truly looking forward to the last books.

I have just recently finished listening to the whole series on Audio thanks to Audible.com. I cannot say how much I enjoyed listening to this series and how great a production it was. I believe that the talents of Michael Kramer and his wife Kate Reading are perfect for this series. I truly imagined myself in the world of The Wheel of Time and I would recommend a listen it to anyone.

RIP [[Robert Jordan | RJ]].
